basis: User decision permits controlled abandonment and supersedes the previous original29815/guarded-closure administrative prerequisite for abandonment only.
Recorded identities, same-owner checks, exact idle descendant tree, original lock inode and wrapper descriptor are checked before signals.
Only individual selected PIDs receive bounded TERM/KILL escalation with fresh identity and immediate-child checks.
Success requires selected processes absent or terminal and nonblocking exclusive flock acquisition on the existing original inode.
No lockfile or evidence deletion; original run remains failed, abandoned and uncredited; original outer exit status stays unknown.
technicalLimits: Static review does not establish current process/lock state or actual recovery success.
Ordinary OS snapshot-to-signal races remain; no atomic process-identity guarantee is claimed.
Bounded waits may fail conservatively under scheduling delay; failure does not authorize broader signals.

postRecoveryIntegrationBoundary.precondition: Actual successful recovery result confirms selected processes terminal/absent and original inode freely lockable.
postRecoveryIntegrationBoundary.supportedWork: Resume already authorized local implementation and fresh checks for pending stories, retaining the existing single-Gradle serialization boundary.
